title: Canonical read-only ONVIF analysis query selector
description: Closed AOP-005 query target over ordered exact existing XML/RTP source identities and roots. The operator binds deployment root and principal outside the MCP selector. Native admission additionally requires unique source identities, canonical digest/integer spellings, 16 KiB sources JSON, 64 KiB zone-policy JSON and an exact current deployment token when supplied. The complete selected semantic row set must fit max_entries; excess refuses without truncation. Responses use the existing AgentResponseEnvelope and AgentCognitiveEnvelope v1 under query/case, with vendor values redacted.

max_entries.description: Complete data rows: shared sources/frames/occurrences/tracklets plus all selected lifecycle document/operation/endpoint/support/behaviour/reuse rows or zone policy/cell/frame/transition rows. Fixed protected scope/privacy statements are additional. No continuation or silent truncation.

anchor.description: Exact current deployment authority/effect-history token, independent of original source publication anchors. Native token parsing is authoritative.
